units.source_text: 幸好，后来的发展没有被先生言中。

en.t: Fortunately, things afterward did not turn out as Sensei had predicted.

units.source_text: 当时不谙世事的我，连先生这段话中那么明显的含意都没有听出来，

en.t: At the time, inexperienced as I was, I did not even catch the obvious meaning in those words of Sensei's.

units.source_text: 我照旧去看望先生，

en.t: I went on visiting Sensei as before,

units.source_text: 不知不觉地在先生家的饭桌上吃饭了，

en.t: and before I knew it, I was eating at the table in his home,

units.source_text: 后来又自然而然地发展到同先生的夫人说话了。

en.t: and later it naturally reached the point where I spoke with Sensei's wife as well.

units.source_text: 作为一个正常人，我对女人并非没有感觉。

en.t: As an ordinary person, I was not without feeling toward women.

units.source_text: 可是，从我有限的经历来看，

en.t: However, judging from my limited experience,

units.source_text: 我几乎没有同女人有过真正意义上的交往。

en.t: I had almost never had anything that could truly be called a relationship with a woman.

units.source_text: 不知道是不是这个缘故，

en.t: I do not know whether that was the reason,

units.source_text: 我才会对大街上遇到的不知根底的女人特别感兴趣，

en.t: but perhaps because of it I took a special interest in women I met on the street, women whose background I knew nothing about,

units.source_text: 前些日子在门前见到先生的夫人时，

en.t: and when I had seen Sensei's wife at the front gate some days earlier,

units.source_text: 便留下了很美的印象。

en.t: she left me with a very beautiful impression.

units.source_text: 以后每次见面，都有同样的感受。

en.t: After that, every time I met her, I felt the same way.

units.source_text: 可是除此之外，我对于夫人也没有什么特别要说的。

en.t: But apart from that, I had nothing particular to say about her.

units.source_text: 这么说并不是因为夫人没什么特色，

en.t: That is not to say that Sensei's wife had no distinctive qualities,

units.source_text: 而应该说没有表现她的特色的时机更恰当些。

en.t: rather, it would be more accurate to say that no occasion arose for those qualities to show themselves.

units.source_text: 不过，我总是把夫人当作附属于先生的一部分来对待。

en.t: Still, I always treated her as if she were a part attached to Sensei.

units.source_text: 夫人似乎也因为我是个来拜访自己丈夫的书生，

en.t: She, too, seemed to regard me kindly because I was a student who came to visit her husband,

units.source_text: 而善意地对待我。

en.t: and she treated me with goodwill.

units.source_text: 因此，如果没有位于中间的先生的话，

en.t: Therefore, if Sensei had not stood between us,

units.source_text: 我和夫人便是毫不相干的两个人。

en.t: she and I would have been two people with no connection at all.

units.source_text: 所以对于刚刚认识不久的夫人，

en.t: So as for the wife whom I had only recently come to know,

units.source_text: 我除了觉得很美之外，再也没有别的感觉了。

en.t: I felt nothing beyond the fact that she was beautiful.
